C1230.title: SAMR Penalizes Meituan for “Choose One from Two” Monopoly Conduct
C1230.summary: In April 2021, the State Administration for Market Regulation opened an antitrust investigation into Meituan over suspected monopolistic practices including “choose one from two” exclusive dealing. On October 8, 2021, SAMR found that Meituan had abused its dominant market position in China's online food delivery platform service market, ordered it to stop the illegal conduct, and imposed a 3.442 billion yuan fine.

references.title: SAMR Imposes Administrative Penalty on Meituan for “Choose One from Two” Monopoly Conduct in China's Online Food Delivery Platform Service Market
